thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT detected: Atlas8b family sustained high TPM (spike to 3.8k TPM) triggering auto-burst-cap. Auto-shape in effect.
sam_oncall: Oncall here — seeing elevated error %, saw surge from a single tenant. Can we reduce per-model burst cap to stabilize? :eyes:
maria_sre: Confirmed. Errors are 502/504 from runtime, not model. Memory spikes on atlas8b instances coincident with long-context requests.
alex_runtime: Agreed. Recommend temporary per-model TPM drop from 3000 -> 600 and disable funcall for atlas8b to cut tails.
lee_support: Customer-impact: two large customers reporting timeouts on chat endpoints, escalating to Customer Ops.
sam_oncall: I'll apply a soft cap now, and create a customer carveout rule for the top-tier tenants — they keep 1:1 capacity.
alex_runtime: Command (running):
```
curl -X POST https://api.internal.redwood.local/admin/quota
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' 
 -d '{"model":"atlas8b","tpm":600,"rpm":60,"disable_funcall":true}'
```
alex_runtime: Applied — response ok, change_id=chg_4932_atlas_cap_01
maria_sre: Watch logs, routing will rebalance in ~30s. Also enabling aggressive KV-prefix cache for atlas8b group.
status-bot: Status page updated: 'Investigating latency and errors impacting atlas8b model family; mitigation in progress.'
lee_support: Notified impacted customers in Slack thread and opened tickets: TKT-773, TKT-774.
sam_oncall: Handoff to maria_sre for monitoring. I'm stepping off pager in 10m. maria, if stable, please lift caps gradually and re-enable funcall in staged canary.
maria_sre: Acknowledged. Setting monitor window 15m, alert if error_rate > 1.5% or p95 latency rises.
jordan_prod: Releasing canary variant routing as fallback: atlas8b -> atlas8b-quantized for non-funcall requests. Will track quality regressions.
maria_sre: 8m in: error rate down 70%, p95 latency improved. No new customer escalations.
lee_support: Customers updated: they're seeing improvements. Keeping tickets open until full recovery. :thumbsup:
sam_oncall: Thanks team — leaving note in incident doc with change_id and recommended postmortem items (traces, tenant replay, root-cause on long-context allocation).
maria_sre: If stable over 30m we'll remove the soft cap and re-enable funcall in staged steps (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
status-bot: Incident autosummary: mitigation applied (per-model TPM/RPM cap; funcall disabled); monitoring ongoing.
